alt: A small white autonomous robot vacuum navigating across a white mattress
story: Creatulize unveiled the X1 Pro at IFA 2026: a fully autonomous robot vacuum designed to crawl across your mattress, cleaning dust mites and skin flakes with UV-C sterilisation, 11 sensors, and four cleaning modes.
why_funny: You now have to unmake your bed so a robot can service it, then remake it — solving the ancient human problem of not wanting to clean the thing you sleep on by adding a robot you also have to manage.
